description: Set Table Options (Table > Table Options): row, column, header and footer counts, the table border, space before and after, stroke drawing order, table direction and alignment in the frame; alternating row and column strokes; alternating fills; and repeating headers and footers, which control how a long table breaks across columns, frames and pages

columnStrokes.description: Column Strokes tab: an alternating pattern of two strokes. first.count and next.count set the pattern

first.description: The first stroke of the column pattern

color.description: A swatch name in the document, or "#RRGGBB" (creates an RGB colour swatch)

count.description: How many columns take the first stroke before the pattern switches

gapColor.description: Colour of the gaps in a dashed, dotted or striped stroke: a swatch name, or "#RRGGBB"

type.description: Stroke style name as in the Stroke panel, e.g. Solid, Dashed, Dotted, Thick - Thin

next.description: The next stroke of the column pattern

color.description: A swatch name in the document, or "#RRGGBB" (creates an RGB colour swatch)

count.description: How many columns take the next stroke before the pattern switches

gapColor.description: Colour of the gaps in a dashed, dotted or striped stroke: a swatch name, or "#RRGGBB"

type.description: Stroke style name as in the Stroke panel, e.g. Solid, Dashed, Dotted, Thick - Thin

skipFirst.description: Skip First: leave this many columns at the start out of the pattern

skipLast.description: Skip Last: leave this many columns at the end out of the pattern

fills.description: Fills tab: alternating fills by row or by column

columnFillsPriority.description: Draw column fills on top of row fills

first.description: The first fill of the alternating pattern

color.description: A swatch name in the document, or "#RRGGBB" (creates an RGB colour swatch)

count.description: How many rows or columns take the first fill before the pattern switches

next.description: The next fill of the alternating pattern

color.description: A swatch name in the document, or "#RRGGBB" (creates an RGB colour swatch)

count.description: How many rows or columns take the next fill before the pattern switches

pattern.description: Alternating Pattern: none, rows or columns (required with first, next, skipFirst or skipLast)

skipFirst.description: Skip First: leave this many rows or columns at the start out of the pattern

skipLast.description: Skip Last: leave this many rows or columns at the end out of the pattern

repeatFooter.description: Repeat Footer: every text column, once per frame, or once per page

repeatHeader.description: Repeat Header: every text column, once per frame, or once per page

skipFirstHeader.description: Skip First: leave the header off the first part of the table

skipLastFooter.description: Skip Last: leave the footer off the last part of the table

rowStrokes.description: Row Strokes tab: an alternating pattern of two strokes. first.count and next.count set the pattern (1 and 1 = every other row)

first.description: The first stroke of the row pattern

color.description: A swatch name in the document, or "#RRGGBB" (creates an RGB colour swatch)

count.description: How many rows take the first stroke before the pattern switches

gapColor.description: Colour of the gaps in a dashed, dotted or striped stroke: a swatch name, or "#RRGGBB"

type.description: Stroke style name as in the Stroke panel, e.g. Solid, Dashed, Dotted, Thick - Thin

next.description: The next stroke of the row pattern

color.description: A swatch name in the document, or "#RRGGBB" (creates an RGB colour swatch)

count.description: How many rows take the next stroke before the pattern switches

gapColor.description: Colour of the gaps in a dashed, dotted or striped stroke: a swatch name, or "#RRGGBB"

type.description: Stroke style name as in the Stroke panel, e.g. Solid, Dashed, Dotted, Thick - Thin

skipFirst.description: Skip First: leave this many rows at the start out of the pattern

skipLast.description: Skip Last: leave this many rows at the end out of the pattern

alignment.description: Table alignment in its frame (the justification of the paragraph holding the table)

border.description: Table Border, applied to all four sides

color.description: A swatch name in the document, or "#RRGGBB" (creates an RGB colour swatch)

gapColor.description: Colour of the gaps in a dashed, dotted or striped stroke: a swatch name, or "#RRGGBB"

type.description: Stroke style name as in the Stroke panel, e.g. Solid, Dashed, Dotted, Thick - Thin

spaceAfter.description: Table Spacing: space after the table in mm

spaceBefore.description: Table Spacing: space before the table in mm

strokeDrawingOrder.description: Stroke Drawing Order: which strokes are drawn on top where row and column strokes meet

table.description: Which table. Give frameId, storyId or pageIndex with index (which table, 0-based), or selection: true for the table holding the selection. Add nested to reach a table inside a cell. get_table_info lists every table with its storyId and index

frameId.description: Id of a text frame; index counts the tables in that frame

nested.description: Path to a table nested in cells: each step goes into the cell at (row, column) of the current table and takes its index-th table

column.description: Column of the cell holding the nested table

row.description: Row of the cell holding the nested table

pageIndex.description: 0-based page index; index counts the tables in the page's text frames, frame by frame

selection.description: Use the table holding the selection: selected cells, a text cursor in a cell, or a selected text frame's first table

storyId.description: Story id; index counts the tables in the story

name: set_table_options
title: Set Table Options
